description: Stereo pitch shifter taken from the STK library

params.text: How much of the voltage at the CV input reaches the amount of shift
The balance between the untreated signal and the shifted signal
Takes the pitch shifter out of the signal path, so the input passes straight to the output

inputs.text: The left side of the stereo input
The right side of the stereo input
A voltage moving the amount of shift
A trigger switches the bypass on and off

outputs.text: The left side of the stereo output
The right side of the stereo output

notes: the amount of shift is set as a percentage by dragging the red display, and the green display below it shows the amount actually in use once the CV input is added
